verdict.rationale: Entra ID provides some adjacent capabilities—diagnostic settings that let admins route/retain activity logs long-term, and Lifecycle Workflows that automate user deprovisioning/removal at end of lifecycle—but there is no documentation of explicit data-retention/deletion controls (e.g., GDPR erasure requests, configurable retention periods for directory/identity data, or AI-specific data handling) framed for an end user's privacy posture. Missing for 10: explicit data retention policy controls, user-initiated deletion/erasure workflows, GDPR/CCPA compliance documentation, and any AI-native data handling specifics.
